name: Instrument: The founding seat description template (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
The instrument that answers the carryover on founder job descriptions (86ajgnhp7): neither founder has one, and the chef partner cannot be told what they own until the other two seats are written down.

Eight elements per seat: domain owned; outcomes the seat is accountable to; decisions held alone; decisions shared; what the seat does not own; the seams with the other seats; relationship to the two parallel leads and to the operating system; the absence rule, meaning what happens in the domain when the seat is not in the building.

Must refuse: interior qualities, strengths, failure modes, and working style. Those belong to each founder's own writing, and to Session 16. The seat description is the outward half only.

Gated on the document methodology, ClickUp task 86ajgn2z5. This item specifies the instrument. It does not build it.

Filed by Session 2. Specification is in sections 7.3 and 12 of the S2 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
